brief:
A widespread digital campaign has launched across social media platforms under the hashtag #YourSilenceIsShame, condemning international inaction over the escalating humanitarian crisis in Gaza, according to Shehab Wire. The campaign denounces the ongoing suffering in the territory and stalled relief efforts.

The initiative calls for urgent intervention to rescue Gaza amid deepening humanitarian conditions. Organizers use the hashtag to pressure the international community to respond to what activists describe as a catastrophic situation requiring immediate global action.
